runsheet.short_description: Optional: Study the 10 papers; Network with presenters.
Join Slack channels corresponding to your session: #oral-session-? and #poster-session-?, and most importantly, #oral-session-?-presenters.
[[On-site Session Chair]] and [[Online Session Chair]] say hi to each other on Slack and agree on how to split the work.

Contact the online presenters of your session. Confirm their pre-recorded video is on Miniconf, and that they will be in their Zoom breakout room during the Poster Session. Tell the [[On-site Session Chair]] about any change.
Tell presenters their session slot and presentation position. Remind each presenter to keep their mode of attendance up to date via Google Form.
runsheet.more_info: If the paper is listed as 'Px-y Title...' on Miniconf and Slack, then it is presented as the y-th paper in Oral Session x.

runsheet.short_description: Use your own laptop to test open all slide submissions. Your laptop will not be used during the Oral Session, but is a good sanity check.
Review name pronunciations. In #oral-session-?-presenters, re-send the presentation order, and remind presenters to sit in the front row.
Join the Zoom Webinar and open #oral-session-? and #poster-session-? on Slack.
Go to the stage laptop and check the [Sheet for Session Chair](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JPkY1TY8BfC07ZicIe6FDiZt94PALu3r6AFXhavpwlY/edit?gid=1217880391#gid=1217880391).
runsheet.more_info:
Do not download slides. During presentation, for Google slides, use the web view; for slides files, downloading is fast. This ensures up-to-date slides.
If the previous event before your session uses the auditorium, do this instead at T-1 min.

runsheet.short_description: [[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit. [[Zoom Master]] says hi to and assist [[On-site Session Chair]] on the stage.
Disable Zoom Chat and raised hand (for attendees).
runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody. Host Tools > attendees > raise hand: off.

runsheet.short_description: In the Zoom webinar, promote the [[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] to panelist; and backstage to cohost.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the presentations --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the auditorium screen visible so any mismatch is caught, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
Sit in the corner of the audience to enjoy the presentations.

Introduce your name, institution, your role as the On-site Session Chair, and, if you want, a 1-sentence research topic. Announce that the Oral Session does NOT have time for Q&A, and introduce your gestures/cards for '2 minutes passed' and '3 minutes passed'.
runsheet.more_info: Cards: maybe simply write with pen and paper?

runsheet.short_description: In #oral-session-?, welcome the online attendees, introduce yourself, and post the presentation order with Miniconf links.

where T<sub>y</sub> is the start of each presentation. Make sure the presenter is ready and by the stage. Open / Download the right slides from the [Sheet for Session Chair](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JPkY1TY8BfC07ZicIe6FDiZt94PALu3r6AFXhavpwlY/edit?gid=1217880391#gid=1217880391). Introduce the paper title and the presenter. Be brief, nice, and non-distracting.
runsheet.more_info:
Tip. Extra words easily distract the audience. The presentations are fast. If a person spends 15 seconds thinking about what you just said, they've missed the first slide.
If the presenter is not ready in 30 seconds, fallback to playing the pre-recorded video.

runsheet.short_description: In #oral-session-?, start a thread for paper y (title, presenter, Miniconf link) for online questions. The Oral Session has no Q&A; the questions are taken to the Poster Session.
Signal the presenter.
Signal the presenter again. From this point on, use your judgement whether to barge in and stop the presentation. Consider remaining time.
runsheet.more_info: If you have to stop a presentation, you can then warmly welcome the audience to the poster of that paper. Remember to be non-distracting.

runsheet.short_description: Announce the end of the Oral Session, thank the presenters, and direct the audience to the Poster location. Check the schedule: if there is a Majlis at the same time, mention its title.
End webinar for all.
runsheet.more_info: Webinar has to end before the Poster Session Zoom Meeting can be started.

runsheet.short_description: In #oral-session-?, thank the presenters and direct online attendees to #poster-session-? for the Poster Session Zoom link.
Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
